description: Saint Martin (French part): Planet Road Surface, Width, and Passability Data is a dataset listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by HeiGIT (Heidelberg Institute for Geoinformation Technology). This dataset provides AI-derived road surface type, road width, road surface change (unpaved to paved), and a Humanitarian Passability Index (HPI) using PlanetScope satellite imagery (2020 and 2024). The analysis focuses on arterial roads classified in OSM as motorway, trunk, primary, and secondary, including their link classes. Coverage: Saint Martin (French part). The portal files it under the publisher HeiGIT (Heidelberg Institute for Geoinformation Technology). Its tags are development, humanitarian access, indicators, logistics, openstreetmap. It offers 2 resource(s) in GEOJSON, GEOPACKAGE. The portal shows 2026-03-02 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is terms recorded on the dataset page: For non-commercial use only.. The HDX page adds that the data contain derivatives of PlanetScope imagery and that redistribution is subject to Planet Labs PBC licensing terms. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
